Open DigiClass

Lessons open with the class code your teacher gives you.

Students: you only type it once on each device. No account or password needed.

Two ways to learn

DigiClass Learn

Study at your own pace. Every topic has clear notes, step-by-step worked examples, code to run, practice at three levels, quizzes with instant feedback, and exam tips.

DigiClass Teach

40-minute classroom lessons led by your teacher: starter, explanation, cooperative activity, higher-order question, plenary and exit ticket, with clear success criteria for every topic.
